title: C# File Handling (System.IO)
description: The 'System.IO' namespace allows you to work with files and directories in C#. The 'File' class provides static methods for creating, copying, deleting, moving, and opening files. This is crucial for persisting data between application restarts.

challenges.title: Write File
challenges.exercise: Print 'File.WriteAllText creates or overwrites a file' to confirm concept.
challenges.expectedOutput: File.WriteAllText creates or overwrites a file
challenges.solution: Console.WriteLine("File.WriteAllText creates or overwrites a file");
